reason: The fix correctly changes CSP directive separator to ';' per spec, but since PermissionsPolicy shares the same PoliciesSeparator constant, it also switches Permissions-Policy (which requires comma-separated directives) to ';', likely producing malformed Permissions-Policy headers for any tenant using that feature.
